style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Candy Cane Garland Christmas Decoration
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a playful twist to your festive decorating with this charming 150cm candy cane garland. Designed with classic red and white striped detailing, it captures the nostalgic spirit of Christmas while adding a bold, eye-catching accent to your home. Perfect for draping along mantelpieces, stair banisters, door frames or Christmas trees, this garland instantly brightens any space with its cheerful seasonal style. The flexible design makes it easy to shape and position exactly where you want it, whether you’re creating a statement feature or layering it with other festive décor. Crafted for long-lasting seasonal use, it offers a decorating solution you can enjoy year after year. The vibrant candy cane finish brings a fun, traditional touch that works beautifully in both modern and classic Christmas themes. Ideal for homes, shops, or festive displays, this garland is a simple yet striking way to spread Christmas cheer throughout any setting. Bring indoors during adverse weather condition
